notes.title: Complete renovatie Update
notes.content:
[b]Dear players.[/b]
We have an obligation to you to deliver a good game.
In our eyes, we have not yet 100% satisfied, because to be able to do we had to switch to a different game engine.
As you already know, that has become Godot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791109/9b8dfffee421ff202ca66b812e46c1dbc50ae018.png[/img]

As a result, a few precious months were lost in the ownership of this game engine.
But now we are ready to make this announcement again.

[b]What is different about the game:[/b]

Well actually the whole game has been turned upside down, all the comments we have received have been included in the rebuild of the game.

Certain parts have been left behind, but they will certainly return.
The most important thing we think is that a game works flawlessly without bugs or other problems. From there we continue again.

[u]The last few parts will be added when they are ready, the update will be carried out.[/u]

We are also working on making this game available to both MAC and LINUX players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32791109/0392f05825928954ecf47558394b321cf79e6ea2.jpg[/img]
For that, we brought in 3 different MAC`s and tested 3 different laptops for the linux.
We already have 4 mirosoft PCs windows 7 2x and window 102x all different versions specially for testing our own games so that we know for sure that our games will run on every system.
We hope to release the mac and linux versions in January 2020

tags.feature: We are also working on making this game available to both MAC and LINUX players.

notes.title: Update about the new December update
notes.content:
[b][u]We have come a long way with the rebuilding of the Game.[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] - Bank is ready.
[*] - Warehouse is ready
[*] - Purchasing is ready.
[*] - Clock is ready.
[/list]
[b][u]What remains is:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] - finacial overview
[*] - Staff
[*] - Advertisement
[*] - start menu
[*] - save and load game option
[/list]

[b][u]What has been added to the game:[/u][/b]

- Raw materials these determine the purchase price
   via the color of face you can see whether it is advantageous or not to buy.
-Manage multiple stores.
  you can expand your emperium and have several shops.

[b][u]Screen options[/u][/b]
we fully support the following screen resolutions
1920x1080 --- 1768x992 ---- 1680x1050----1600x1024.
1600x900 ----- 1440x900 ---- 1366x768 ---- 1360x768.
1280x960 -----1280x768 -----1280 x 720 ----1176 x 664.
1152x864 -----1024x768.

the Most image has been improved.

We have been told a number of times about the translation that was not correct
[u][h1]Due to the early sale we could hire someone for the translation.
Thanks for that :)[/h1][/u]

The translation that will be made are:
[b]  English, German, French[/b]

notes.title: Our new update is about image quality and resolution
notes.content:
Our new update is about image quality and resolution

This update will ensure that the game can be played in full screen.
Without the quality of the image going badly.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/a563dc59b4391d64c74342397f759ed69de40d2d.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/0cfb139d5832dbeedd15d6290696d4051488a523.jpg[/img][/url]

It does require some rewriting of the existing code.
so the update will take some time.

As a result, I can not work on new applications in the game.
It is important to me that the players must be able to experience complete gaming pleasure.
that's why I've pulled this update forward.

As soon as this update is finished I will immediately upload it to Steam and inform you about it.

The Update will bring the following:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/d7ad1413a4e1aee3ff2d351efba682cba6603ff8.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/53bcdca18df88f5fbd989435dc5d72e2782eb826.png[/img][/url]

[b]- Game will run on the next resolution[/b]
[list]
[*]800x600
[*]1366x768
[*]1600x900
[*]1920x1080
[*]2560x1440
[*]2560x1600
[/list]
*And every other screen resolution that fits between here.*
[h1]- some image is recreated.[/h1]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/ecdf5eeabb2eae2d09c81d4d9fb12836ed7e5acf.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/63dcd5a5c27afef4f2733b248f989635932ea686.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: A new update is coming out today. version: 7.0
notes.content:
[h1]A new update is coming out today. version: 7.0[/h1]

When you start a store you come to a new screen.
Here you can choose your own store.
Red round is crowded area.
Orange round is normally visited
And the green is low-visited territory (not yet active)
Each store has its advantage and disadvantages such as rent price, warehouse space, electricity costs.

Once you have chosen a store, you only have to decide how long you want to rent the store.
When you have done that, you have a store.
Through the globe in the office you come to the stores.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/501a3457789d4301e273d2ce29403456ec1174a9.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32791109/4cec854dcc3dea54d15c03182cf228a87ccbe5bb.jpg[/img][/url]
During the rental period you can not change shop.
After the end of the rental contract, go to the stores for a new lease or maybe you choose another store

notes.title: Update save system
notes.content:

Now I have restored it so that you can load both the normal save and the autosave.

Good luck

Regards,
Alexander jnagame

notes.title: error restored
notes.content:
[h1]First mistake:[/h1]
After the first week the screen remained in black, when you clicked the clock again with the mouse.

[h1]The second mistake:[/h1]
Was that after the first week, that you no longer got customers, this was caused by sick staff regardless of whether or not you had staff.

After further thorough testing, I could not find any other errors.
So now I can continue to develop the new part of the game.
